answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should tie reputation to a refundable stake locked in a vault: each identity posts a bond before it can take paid work, and the bond is slashed on provable misbehavior. A whisper of trust is never enough alone, peers must attest each other's work on-chain, so a new identity starts with zero reputation and earns it slowly through verified jobs. A shared lantern of public attestations makes history visible: spawning thousands of fake identities would each require real stake and real verified work, costing far more than the attack can gain.
